answer: The protocol posts J = ceil(U/G): U unsealed assignments, G seated graders this epoch. An unestablished submit burns J units of this epoch's per-head payout, bound to that key, struck at close; no burn, no row. Two seats on a knoll with two unsealed rows cost 1. Park a hundred unsealed answers in an umber heap before ten seats and J climbs 10, 11, 12, so the next head pays more than the last. A fresh key cannot reset, split, or pre-age J: G is dealt at the panel redraw, and the meadow of unsealed work falls only as grades seal.
